description: This file implements the hybi draft WebSocket protocol, including frame reading/writing, handshake procedures, and connection setup for client and server sides.

classes.name: hybiFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a hybi WebSocket frame, including flags, op code, length, masking key, and associated data buffer.

classes.name: hybiFrameReader
classes.description: Reads and processes incoming hybi WebSocket frames, handling masking and payload extraction.

classes.name: hybiFrameReaderFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating hybiFrameReader instances based on connection data.

classes.name: hybiFrameWriter
classes.description: Writes hybi WebSocket frames, including framing headers and masking payloads if needed.

classes.name: hybiFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating hybiFrameWriter instances for different payload types.

classes.name: hybiFrameHandler
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frames, managing masking rules, control frames, and connection closure.

classes.name: hybiServerHandshaker
classes.description: Performs server-side handshake for hybi draft WebSocket protocol, validating headers and accepting connections.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from hybiFrameReader, applying masking if necessary.

methods.name: PayloadType
methods.description: Returns the opcode of the current frame.

methods.name: HeaderReader
methods.description: Returns an io.Reader for the frame header data.

methods.name: TrailerReader
methods.description: Returns nil, as trailers are not used.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the total length of the frame.

methods.name: NewFrameReader
methods.description: Creates a new frame reader by parsing the frame header from the connection.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into a hybi frame, framing and masking as needed.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the frame writer (no operation).

methods.name: NewFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a new frame writer for a specific payload type.

methods.name: HandleFrame
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, handling masking rules, control frames, and errors.

methods.name: WriteClose
methods.description: Sends a close frame with a status code.

methods.name: WritePong
methods.description: Sends a pong frame with a message.

methods.name: newHybiConn
methods.description: Creates a new hybi protocol WebSocket connection.

methods.name: generateMaskingKey
methods.description: Generates a 4-byte masking key for frames.

methods.name: generateNonce
methods.description: Generates a base64-encoded 16-byte nonce for handshake.

methods.name: removeZone
methods.description: Removes IPv6 zone identifier from host string.

methods.name: getNonceAccept
methods.description: Computes the expected Sec-WebSocket-Accept header value from a nonce.

methods.name: hybiClientHandshake
methods.description: Performs client-side handshake for hybi WebSocket protocol.

methods.name: newHybiClientConn
methods.description: Creates a new client WebSocket connection after handshake.

methods.name: ReadHandshake
methods.description: Reads and validates the server handshake request.

methods.name: AcceptHandshake
methods.description: Sends the server handshake response.

methods.name: NewServerConn
methods.description: Creates a new server-side WebSocket connection.
